Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world, action-adventure story set in Night City, a megalopolis obsessed with power, glamour and body modification. You play as V, a mercenary outlaw going after a one-of-a-kind implant that is the key to immortality.
How long is Cyberpunk 2077?
When focusing on the main objectives, Cyberpunk 2077 is about 26 Hours in length. If you're a gamer that strives to see all aspects of the game, you are likely to spend around 109 Hours to obtain 100% completion.
Cyberpunk 2077 will take you approximately 6 Weeks to complete if you play for 1.5 hours a day while focusing on some extra content.
